summary: Verified the rupee icon bug fix on the doctor detail screen (/doctor/11, Dr AP Singh). The Fee row now renders a styled Text '₹' symbol (DOM: DIV:'₹' + DIV:'Fee', no SVG, no question mark). Qualifications/award, Experience/briefcase, City/map-pin Feather icons all render correctly (react-native-web renders vector icons as font glyphs, not SVGs — confirmed visually via screenshots). Page loads clean: zero console errors, no Feather/DetailRow warnings, no red screen. Fee value shows '₹10'. All 3 test criteria PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: DetailRow component correctly branches on symbol vs icon prop (/app/frontend/app/doctor/[id].tsx:525-543); fallback icon is 'info' which exists in Feather.
Icon names used across the screen (award, briefcase, map-pin, star, globe, video, calendar, arrow-left, arrow-right, alert-circle) are all valid Feather glyphs — no other phantom icons found.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing doctor id=11 (Dr AP Singh)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug verified fixed. On react-native-web, vector icons render as font-glyph text nodes, not <svg> — DOM checks for SVG presence will return false even when icons render fine; verify icons visually via screenshots. Doctor detail route does not require auth on web preview.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: Feather icon set has no 'rupee' glyph, so the icon renderer fell back to a question-mark-in-box. Fix: Fee DetailRow now passes symbol="₹" and DetailRow renders a styled <Text>₹</Text> (styles.detailSymbol) instead of a Feather icon. Verified: DOM contains '₹' text in the Fee row label wrap; no '?' glyph; value '₹10' rendered via formatINR. Mitigation in place and working.
